successor_context_corrections.text: The 2005 source reports earlier Cu(II)/Cd(II) FucO inhibition and cites PMID4306747. Retained evidence for the older paper is abstract/landing material; its full experimental body was not inspected. Figure 4 tests Zn/Fe, so no Cu/Cd dose, EG oxidation effect, binding mechanism or new causal edge is asserted.

evidence.source_assertion: The 2005 discussion reports earlier FucO inhibition by Cu(II) and Cd(II), citing reference 40. This is prior-work context; the adjacent Figure 4 experiment addresses Zn/Fe.
Reference 40 links the earlier oxidoreductase study to PMID4306747. This citation identifies the prior report; it does not supply a freshly inspected older experimental body.

successor_context_corrections.text: The 0.53 Fe atom/subunit WT solution comparator occurs in a site-directed-mutant comparison. Methods assign those WT/mutant preparations to pCM2 GST/factor-Xa cleavage in BL21(DE3). This is an explicit Methods/Results attribution, distinct from pCM1 His6 crystal-site evidence, and is not universal iron occupancy.

evidence.source_assertion: Methods state that WT and mutant FucO preparations for site-directed-mutagenesis studies used pGEX3X/pCM2 in BL21(DE3), with GST removed by factor Xa to avoid the His6 tag.

Results compare D196L, H200A and H200F metal contents with WT examined in parallel, reporting 0.53 Fe atom/subunit for WT. Read with the preparation Methods, this supports the cleaved-WT comparator attribution, not His6 crystal occupancy.
